chapter_seo_title: Chapter 412: Stirring the Seas Beyond—The Celestial Corpse Flame
chapter_meta_description: A Nascent Soul master wielding instant-death black fire delivers a terrifying ultimatum. Han Li must calculate survival against a leash that demands his soul.
og_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality Ch. 412
og_description: Extreme Yin's newly mastered Celestial Corpse Flame vaporizes a Core Formation cultivator in seconds. A soul-branding ultimatum forces a desperate alliance.
twitter_title: RMJI Ch. 412: Black Fire, Soul Brands, a Desperate Stand
twitter_description: Han Li faces a Nascent Soul's black fire. No one can dodge it. No one can block it. The only way out is a leash on your very soul.

lore_anchors.definition: A devastating black flame technique that burns the target to ash in seconds; its speed and power exceed that of ordinary demonic flames, making it a signature attack of Revered Ancestor Extreme Yin.

A forbidden technique only usable by Nascent Soul cultivators; the victim gives up a fragment of their primordial soul onto a branded tablet, giving the caster absolute control over their life and mind.
Black wooden plaques used to seal a fraction of a cultivator’s primordial soul; destroying the tablet destroys that portion of the soul, causing permanent mental damage or death.
A technique where a high-level cultivator projects their consciousness into a remote host body; the possessed body cannot sustain full power for long without being destroyed.
Han Li’s signature flying sword, crafted from rare materials and imbued with his Core Formation mana.
Elder Chi Huo’s signature cultivation art, known for its water-element power and compatibility with defensive and corrosive techniques in the Chaotic Star Seas.
The supreme authorities of the Star Palace, nominal enforcers of order in the Chaotic Star Seas; their inability to leave Heavenly Star City signals a power vacuum.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Extreme Yin’s black fire kill so fast?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The Celestial Corpse Flame is a high-tier Nascent Soul technique that burns both body and soul, and it possesses extreme speed—far beyond what ordinary flying treasures can evade.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is the Soul-Branding Art so feared?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It allows a Nascent Soul cultivator to enslave someone permanently; handing over a third of your primordial soul means the master can harm or kill you by simply destroying the tablet.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What does Han Li’s unease mean for the story?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It signals that Extreme Yin’s plan has a hidden layer—likely a trump card or an ambush that the allies haven’t accounted for.
